components.adverse_selection: HOLD_TO_SETTLEMENT: carried by the outcome; sub-minute adverse selection UNMEASURED
components.fees: BETTOR published schedule, taker, at the executable ask
components.rebate: 0.0 (taker path; maker path not admissible without measured maker fill/AS -- see Profitability Stack)

10_conservative_executable_ev.formula: net = p_frozen - executable_ask - fee - slippage - adverse_selection - management + rebate

haircuts.calibration: walk-forward ECE of the frozen model in that sport x family x regime (pooled if unmeasured)
haircuts.correlation_capacity: every aggregate is an event-clustered bootstrap bound; one game = one draw
haircuts.execution: slippage upper 90% bound (event-clustered) from paper fills entered before the holdout
haircuts.probability: z*sqrt(p(1-p)/events at the calibration level used); 0 for a prior

reasons: SELECTED_MODEL_IS_THE_PINNACLE_PRIOR: BETTOR's own calibration / residual / internal model added nothing beyond Pinnacle out of sample
12_capital_verdict.rule: CHALLENGER requires every hard check plus forward shadow evidence; SHADOW when only forward evidence is missing; otherwise CASH

selection.selected_on: pooled walk-forward OOS event-weighted log loss

7_loss_contribution_waterfall.identity: error = outcome_vs_market + bettor_disagreement + execution + management + settlement; management = spread_cost + outcome_luck + unattributed (sales with no venue book within 300 s)
